facts.fact: Law no. 2025-011 of 24 February 2025, promulgated by the President after adoption by the National Assembly, replaces articles 15, 31 and 34 of the Civil Status Code (law no. 2011-003 of 12 January 2011), an ordinary law that covers the national biometric population register and secure identity documents.
facts.system: Code de l'Etat Civil (loi n° 2011-003, as amended by loi n° 2025-011)

facts.fact: The amended Civil Status Code, in new article 31, provides for the Registre National Biométrique des Populations, whose data changes are authorised by the structure named in article 6 of the 2011 Code, and new article 15 provides for secure-title applications and digital civil status acts through adopted information systems.
facts.system: Code de l'Etat Civil (loi n° 2011-003, as amended by loi n° 2025-011)

systems.owner: structure named in article 6 of the 2011 Civil Status Code
